proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: work with tangent vectors in fibres via the cited varieties equation; a vector theta in the first factor is the image of theta under the map induced by (1, e) : G_s -> G_s x G_s; since m o (1, e) = 1 functoriality sends theta to theta, and linearity of the induced map gives (theta_1, theta_2) -> theta_1 + theta_2 (source lines 917-927)
